content:
alex: FYI — we need a quick cross-team sync on the new error taxonomy metrics before the canary rollout next week. main asks: consistent names, dashboard panels, and which signals the console will use for degraded-mode UX.
maria: Agree. Biggest open questions: 1) What counts as a fallback vs degraded mode? 2) Do we emit per-model or per-route counts? 3) How do quotas feed into routing decisions (reject vs queue)?
sam: For counting: suggest these metrics
- runtime.error.timeout_total
- runtime.error.5xx_total
- runtime.oom_total
- runtime.fallback.count
- routing.quota.rejected_total
- routing.quota.queued_current
We should include labels: model, route, region, tier
ingrid: +1. Also include a boolean label 'degraded=true' when we return a graceful fallback so dashboards can differentiate hard failures vs graceful degraded responses.
ryan: Console/UX note: we want a single 'Reliability' card that shows 3 small panels: latency/timeouts, 5xx rate, fallback rate. Fallback rate should be normalized per successful responses AND per attempted requests — otherwise it confuses users.
devex: For SDKs we can surface a simple API: client.metrics.increment("fallback", {model, route, reason:"cache_miss"}) and have server translate to runtime.fallback.count; but we need a spec for accepted labels.
sam: Proposal for PromQL snippets to standardize panels:

# fallback rate per minute per route
sum(rate(runtime_fallback_count{route!="",region="$region"}[1m])) by (route) / sum(rate(requests_total{route!="",region="$region"}[1m])) by (route)

# 5xx rate
sum(rate(runtime_error_5xx_total[5m])) by (route) / sum(rate(requests_total[route!=""][5m])) by (route)

maria: Good. Need to decide aggregation for quotas. I propose:
- routing.quota.rejected_total{route,quota_name}
- routing.quota.queued_current{route}
And an alert if rejected_total rate spikes > 0.5% of requests for 15m.
ingrid: On the runtime side, OOMs are noisy. We should emit both container-ish OOMs and model-serve OOMs: runtime.oom_total{oom_type="container"|"model"}. That will help SRE triage.
alex: Cross-team action items:
- eng-runtime: emit the metrics listed with labels (model, route, region, tier, degraded, reason)
- eng-platform: provide standardized PromQL and dashboard templates
- console: wire the 3-panel reliability card and the alerting thresholds
- devex: publish SDK metric helpers + label schema
Can people ack and add owners?
ryan: Console owner for wiring: ryan — will add panels and create a JSON dashboard template that can be parameterized by org and region.
sam: runtime owner: sam — will start a PR to export the metrics with the agreed labels. I'll add instrumented places for fallback increments and OOM tagging.
ingrid: SRE/infra owner: ingrid — will verify OOM metrics and add a node-level fallback to ignore infra-level OOMs in the model-level graphs.
devex: i'll own the SDK helpers and docs (devex). will open a spec doc with expected labels.
maria: i'll own alerting thresholds and rollout plan for alerts (prod-safe gradual increase). will coordinate with ryan for console alert UI.
alex: timeline: get metric exports by EOD Wed, dashboard/json templates by Fri, alert PRs early next week. if blockers surface, ping #eng-oncall and drop a short thread here.
deploy-bot: milestone created: "reliability-metrics-rollout" assigned to alex, sam, ryan, ingrid, devex, maria
ryan: quick UX question — do we want a per-route toggle in the console to hide low-traffic routes? otherwise the panel noise is bad. I propose default: show top 10 routes by request volume, with an expandable list.
maria: yes please. also add breadcrumbs to go from a route panel to the model-specific timeline and the request traces link.
alex: perfect. last ask: include an example payload spec in the dashboard doc for how the console will fetch aggregated metrics (time window, group_by labels, top_k param). devex/sam can pair on that.
sam: noted. i'll include example API contract in the PR: /api/internal/metrics/aggregate?from=...&to=...&group_by=route,model&top_k=10
devex: ack, pairing session thursday morning?
ryan: ack, thursday 10am works. i'll draft dashboard skeleton before then.
ingrid: i'll run a short loadtest to ensure the new counters don't regress runtime perf; will report any cardinality issues.
alex: thanks everyone — let's follow up in the PRs. cc @oncall if anything spikes during rollout.
